messages:
maria: Nightly eval (master->int4-rollout) shows a big drop on a small mixed-script zh->en prompt set — mainly where the source contains inline Latin (product names, code). failing BLEU and a lot of weird punctuation loss. job: https://ci.internal/runs/8421 :eyes:

eval-bot: summary: job 8421, suite=nightly-multilang-v2, subset=zh_mixed_script_64. metric: BLEU -12.4 vs baseline, COMET -0.8. examples attached in artifact bundle: gs://redwood-evals/8421/artifacts/failures.json

liang: thanks. can you paste 1-2 minimal failing examples here?

maria: sure — copy/paste from artifact:
```
input: "在我们的产品 FooBar Pro 2.0 中，用户可以访问 /api/v1/login。请翻译成英文。"
baseline (fp16): "In our product FooBar Pro 2.0, users can access /api/v1/login. Please translate into English."
int4 (rolled): "In our product FooBar Pro 2.0 users can access api v1 login Please translate into English"
issues: lost slashes, lost punctuation, tokenization of Latin segments, worse casing, extra sentence fusion.
```

yuki: who rolled int4 to nightly? i thought rollout was staged only to canary. did we push quantized kernels to the int4 variant pool?

maria: @yuki looks like the new kernel selector landed in serving yesterday, auto-routing int4 variant into nightly. config: `kernel_selector=v2-priority-int4` in the job manifest.

ben: interesting — this feels like a detokenization postprocess bug when source contains ASCII tokens mixed w/ CJK. maybe the whitespace rebuild step assumes whitespace-tokenized input.

kai: quick check: is the vocabulary different between fp16 and int4 artifacts? any remapping step?

liang: i pulled the token lists: fp16 and int4 use same vocab, but quant model build reserialized tokenizer metadata with `normalize_space=true` flagged accidentally.

maria: that would explain it. the int4 tokenizer metadata shows `normalize_space:true` while baseline had `normalize_space:false`. sample before/after tokenization:
```
orig: 在我们的产品 FooBar Pro 2.0 中，用户...
fp16 tokens: [在, 我们, 的, 产品, , FooBar, , Pro, , 2.0, , 中, ，, 用户]
int4 tokens: [在, 我们, 的, 产品, FooBar, Pro, 2.0, 中, 用户]  # merged ASCII with removed punctuation markers
```

yuki: ok that's a metadata bug in tokenizer-serializer. can we revert the serializer change in the model build pipeline and re-run the eval?

maria: plan suggestion:
- revert serializer flag in build (yuki)
- re-run quant grid for affected models (yuki + liang)
- add unit test for mixed-script tokenization (ben)
- create fallback policy in serving: if tokenizer metadata mismatch detected, route to fp16 variant for that request signature (maria)

ben: i'll open a quick PR for the unit test. sample test cases? i'll include: CJK+ASCII urls, product names, inline code snippets, emoji+latin.

liang: i'll run a narrow bisect on commits touching tokenizer/serialize since last green. starting at commit 0f9a..HEAD. will post results in ~30m.

maria: does this warrant a rollback of the production int4 rollout? i think only nightly got auto-routed, but double-checking.

kai: no prod traffic affected that i can see — dashboard shows canary and prod still pinned to `variant: fp16` for that model family. nightly fleet got the new selector only.

eval-bot: note: added regression label `mixed-script-tokenize` to job 8421; linked issue created: RDW-ML-1976.

yuki: will revert serializer in build pipeline, rehydrate models, run evals. assigning to self. ETA 3h for rerun and preliminary pass.

maria: thanks. once rerun is green we should update the rollout checklist to include mixed-script unit tests and add a check in deployment gating.

ben: quick Q — should we also consider a post-tokenize debug hook that emits diffs for ASCII spans? helpful for future triage.

liang: good idea. i'll sketch a lightweight hook that logs span-level tokenization diffs for failing eval examples. low QPS.

maria: sounds good. i'll follow up with an RFC for fallback routing policy after we confirm root cause. :thumbsup:

kai: ping if you need infra for reruns — can provision extra GPUs for 2h window.

maria: appreciated. i'll post status in this thread when rerun finishes.

yuki: started revert PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/serializer/pulls/214 — CI queued.

(liang reacted with :eyes:)

maria: update 11m: bisect found patch 0d3c9 introduced `normalize_space` default flip in tokenizer serializer. confirming fix in PR.

maria: update 40m: rerun queued (job 8434), expected finish in ~45m. artifact link: https://ci.internal/runs/8434

maria: final: rerun job 8434 shows BLEU delta vs baseline now -0.3. tests pass for mixed-script set. closing RDW-ML-1976 after docs + unit test merged. thanks all. :tada:
